boundaries: Metric and domain weights are declared research choices; they are not learned truths.
Mental labels such as awareness, reaction speed and game IQ are not inferred from box scores.
A shared dimension means the ideas are comparable enough to form a hypothesis, not identical across sports.

dimensions.description: Turning chances or possessions into points and goals.
dimensions.label: Scoring and finishing

dimensions.description: Creating useful chances or moving possession to teammates.
dimensions.label: Creation and distribution

dimensions.description: Avoiding costly losses and protecting possession or field position.
dimensions.label: Possession security

dimensions.description: Interrupting an opponent through pressure, stops, takeaways or prevention.
dimensions.label: Defensive disruption

dimensions.description: Regaining control after a contest, shot or loose-ball event.
dimensions.label: Recovery and rebounding

dimensions.description: Moving play toward a valuable area or improving field position.
dimensions.label: Progression and territory

dimensions.description: Producing useful outcomes while limiting avoidable errors or penalties.
dimensions.label: Discipline and efficiency

fields.description: How much evidence the player's playing time supplies, from 0 to 1. It rises as opportunity grows.
fields.label: Opportunity reliability

fields.description: The declared share of the role score whose source statistics are actually present for this player-season.
fields.formula: available weighted metrics / declared weighted metrics
fields.label: Statistic coverage

fields.description: The declared share of broad role areas with at least one usable source statistic.
fields.formula: available weighted role areas / declared weighted role areas
fields.label: Role-area coverage

fields.description: The influence a positive-opportunity player-season receives during training; weaker opportunity or coverage reduces that influence.
fields.formula: opportunity reliability x statistic coverage, limited to 0.05-1.00
fields.label: Season training weight

reliability_weighting.next_season_pair: For next-season models, the pair weight is the geometric mean of the prior- and next-season training weights. Frozen evaluation still uses eligible rows only.
reliability_weighting.training_cohort_claim: Eligible and positive-opportunity low-sample labels may train with empirical opportunity/coverage weights. Frozen evaluation remains eligible-only, and rows must satisfy the deployed build and fixed-dimension requirements.

score_contract.cross_sport_transfer_guesstimate: Unvalidated target-role analogy using build plus a fixed intersection of sport-relative performance dimensions.
score_contract.native_build_profile_forecast_percentile: Next-season benchmark using only build and canonical playing-profile dimensions; checked against build alone.
score_contract.native_forecast_percentile: Next-season estimate using only information available before that season.
